summary: RSM Reinsurance Software Marketplace — full E2E review (first testing-agent run). Created comprehensive pytest suite (42 tests, 100% pass) covering auth, submission packs, marketplace list+detail, interests, operations, NCA signing + identity reveal, chat, quote, contract signing, admin, audit log, and negative cases. Frontend UI smoke test confirmed landing quick-access buttons, role switching, pack card → /app/marketplace/:id navigation, and admin panel. Backend is in excellent shape; UI nav is working; flagged a couple of UX concerns for main agent.

ui_bugs.issue: After switching roles round-trip (Cedente → Reasegurador → Cedente → Admin → Cedente), the dashboard shows KPIs=0 and 'Sin datos todavía' for Mis Programas / Operaciones, even though the user has 2 packs and 1 operation. Data still exists on backend (verified via /api/stats/dashboard and /api/submission-packs/mine). Likely a stale-state / missing refetch on role-switch callback.

Language toggle data-testid 'lang-toggle' not found. The ES/EN toggle exists visually (top of sidebar and landing header) but lacks the expected testid, making it hard to automate. Verify correct testid or add one.

issues: Card showing '€3215' for 'Prova 1' Primas Y-1 looks like test leftover data — not a bug but worth cleaning up demo seed.

action_items: Investigate Cedente dashboard stale-empty state after role switch round-trip — ensure useEffect refetches /api/stats/dashboard and /api/submission-packs/mine whenever the auth token changes.
Add or confirm data-testid='lang-toggle' for the ES/EN switcher to ease future testing.
(Optional) Clean up low-quality leftover pack 'Prova 1' from the demo seed to present a cleaner marketplace.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1344 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, packs, marketplace, operations, messages, broker, admin) for maintainability (>700 line guideline).
accept_quote endpoint does not validate that the quote hasn't already been accepted — repeated calls would create duplicate contracts. Add a guard: if op.get('contract_id') raise 400.

sign_contract allows a user in another role (neither cedente nor reasegurador party) to hit the endpoint only if their id matches — correct, but there is no guard against signing twice (signed_cedente/signed_reasegurador idempotent overwrite). Consider rejecting double-sign like NCA does.

CORS is set to '*' with allow_credentials=True via cookie auth — browsers will refuse cookies on wildcard origins. For production deployment explicit origins must be listed (this is fine in dev but flag for prod).
audit() swallows no errors (good) but there is no index on audit_log.timestamp/action — will degrade with volume.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (navigation, role switch, landing quick-access, admin panel all work; one stale-state UX issue)

test_credentials: Used seeded demo credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md — cedente@demo.eu / reasegurador@demo.eu / broker@demo.eu (Demo123!) and admin@rsm.eu (Admin123!). All authenticated successfully.
seed_data_creation: Backend test created one new submission pack titled 'TEST_XL_Property_2026_<hash>', expressed interest from reasegurador, accepted it, completed full operation lifecycle through 'closed' state. One closed operation (OP-F22840 / Helvetia Re Demo AG) is now persisted in the demo DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is solid — the pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py exercises the entire reinsurance lifecycle end-to-end (landing → publish pack → express interest → accept → NCA bilateral sign → identity reveal → chat → quote → accept quote → contract bilateral sign → closed state) plus admin/audit/negative cases. All 42 tests pass in ~4.6 s. The test creates a fresh pack each run (unique UUID in title) so it is idempotent and safe to re-run. If retesting UI, note that the reasegurador demo account has already expressed interest on the TEST pack created during this run, so the 'Expresar interés' button will not re-appear on that specific pack — either create a new pack first or use a different pack id. Dashboard stale-state after role switch is the main UX issue to verify after fix.
rca of the issue: Dashboard stale-state: after clicking 'switch-cedente' in Sidebar, the app navigates to /app but the dashboard component either (a) does not trigger its data-fetch useEffect because the auth context reference is re-used, or (b) briefly shows the 'empty' initial state before refetch completes and screenshot caught it. Recommend adding an explicit dependency on the current user id in the dashboard's useEffect and/or showing a skeleton loader instead of empty KPIs.
